notes: Three taḥwīl routes meet at Waki'; the names after him («الأعمش، عن أبي وائل، عن عبد الله») are written once, in the last route, and are shared by all three (rule 3). Each route ends at Waki' in the text.
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss and is left out. The Ash'ath story after the saying has no transmitter, so it is not a route.
Companion Abd Allah (ibn Mas'ud) is named bare; nothing is completed from memory.
